entries.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
entries.date_label: **Date: November 9 — new model versions.** Anthropic introduced improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision; it describes Fable and Mythos as the same underlying model, with stronger cybersecurity and biology safeguards on Fable and verified organizational access for Mythos.[19]

entries.title: Meta Muse Ember
entries.date_label: **Date: November 9 — model/API release.** Meta made `muse-ember-1.0` available through Muse Code and the Meta Model API for recurring agent work such as tool calls, routing, extraction, and coding subtasks, with text, image, audio, and video understanding and a one-million-token context window.[24]

entries.title: Gemini 4 Carbon developer access
entries.date_label: **Date: November 10 — broader availability, not the original model announcement.** Google opened Carbon through the paid API tier in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, with access for Google AI Ultra subscribers in AI Studio and Antigravity.[18]

entries.title: Gemini Decision 1 and the Gemini Decisions API
entries.date_label: **Date: November 11 — specialized model and endpoint.** Google's `gemini-decision-1` scores up to 1,000 bounded questions over shared text, images, audio, video, or PDFs in one forward pass, rather than using a general text-generation response for each decision.[26]

entries.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
entries.date_label: **Date: November 12 — new model release.** Google introduced Hydrogen for everyday coding and agentic execution, with availability through the Gemini API, AI Studio, consumer products, and eligible Antigravity subscriptions.[20]

entries.title: Inkling 2 Small weights become downloadable
entries.date_label: **Date: November 12 — open-weight milestone.** Thinking Machines Lab added a dated update making Inkling 2 Small's weights downloadable, following its November 5 closed-weight launch, and listed integrations including SGLang, vLLM, Unsloth, and TokenSpeed.[21]

entries.title: Runway Praxis-1 open release
entries.date_label: **Date: November 11 — weights and code release.** Runway released weights plus inference and fine-tuning code for Praxis-1 under Apache 2.0, including commercial use; the model itself had been introduced in September.[25]

entries.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5
entries.date_label: **Date: November 10 — model announcement and partner rollout.** DeepMind introduced a vision-language-action model and said it was rolling out to robotics partners, not unrestricted public download or general API access.[23]

entries.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
entries.date_label: **First arXiv submission: November 12; v1 read.** This paper separates upstream visual pretraining, dedicated visual capacity, and the placement of that capacity in matched lifetime-compute experiments.[38]

entries.title: WorkflowArena
entries.date_label: **First arXiv submission: November 9; v1 read.** WorkflowArena introduces 145 long-horizon tasks across eight domains to evaluate models that author executable multi-agent workflows.[28][29]

entries.title: SinkState
entries.date_label: **First arXiv submission: November 10; v1 read.** SinkState uses adaptive low-rank SVD representations, buffered updates, and asynchronous CPU consolidation to compress hybrid models' recurrent states.[30][31]

entries.title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache
entries.date_label: **First arXiv submission: November 9; v1 read.** The proposed causal encoder-decoder puts recurrence in the encoder and trains with stochastic recurrence depth to share KV representations across layers and rounds.[32][33]

entries.title: SignRot
entries.date_label: **First arXiv submission: November 12; v1 read.** SignRot adds sign adjustments to Hadamard rotations to address outlier-induced split activation distributions, paired with asymmetric quantization.[36][37]

entries.title: AlphaProof Code verifies bounded Signal implementation properties
entries.date_label: **Date: November 10 — technical report and artifacts.** DeepMind introduced a human-guided multi-agent framework for Lean specifications and machine-checked proofs of cryptographic implementation properties.[9]

entries.title: Chain-of-thought monitorability across the model lifecycle
entries.date_label: **Date: November 10 — OpenAI safety study.** OpenAI studied how pretraining, architecture, reinforcement learning, and model-generated data affect no-chain-of-thought capability and control over visible reasoning traces.[10]

entries.title: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen a backdoor
entries.date_label: **Date: November 10 — Anthropic Fellows/Truthful AI study.** In constructed experiments, poisoned examples that have little effect alone induce a hidden behavior when mixed with clean, contrastive examples lacking the trigger.[11]

entries.title: Worse Together / MAMUBench
entries.date_label: **Date: November 11 — multi-user coordination study.** Researchers tested agents representing different users sharing budgets, schedules, orders, or merge queues and released three environments as MAMUBench.[12]

entries.title: Stress-Testing Sandbagging Detection Under Adaptive Attack
entries.date_label: **First arXiv submission: November 11; v1 read.** The study fine-tunes small open-weight models to fail GSM8K selectively under audit markers, then adapts the attack against a text-based detector.[34][35]

entries.title: Google TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems
entries.date_label: **Date: November 9 — hardware-system announcements.** Google expanded its eighth-generation portfolio with TPU 8tx for confidential inference/private customization and TPU 8i Max for memory-intensive, long-context workloads.[15]

entries.title: SGLang-Neuron on AWS Trainium
entries.date_label: **Date: November 12 — public serving integration.** AWS announced SGLang-Neuron through an AWS Deep Learning Container, enabling model serving and RL rollouts on Trainium through the SGLang interface.[13]

entries.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 on Cloudflare Workers AI
entries.date_label: **Date: November 12 — platform availability milestone.** Cloudflare added `@cf/google/embeddinggemma-2`, describing a shared embedding space for text/code, images, video, and audio, with 768-dimensional outputs and optional shorter vectors.[14]

entries.title: DeepSeek application APIs
entries.date_label: **Date: November 13 — application/API expansion, not a new base model.** DeepSeek's dated changelog exposes application capabilities including web search, file input, URL reading, safety, ASR, and TTS, through built-in integrations or standalone APIs.[22]
